name: NEO broad verified-flow PAPER execution and outcome feedback
policy: A broader market candidate rule joins four selective rules in the shared PAPER account. Every entry still requires fresh confirmed exact-pool flow, completed same-pool safety, independently verified price, executable quotes and strict risk/cost limits. Current-policy closed trades are attributed to matched rules; a rule may be throttled only after at least 12 closes show weak posterior win rate and negative net PnL. This does not establish or promise profitability. Version V4 prospectively adds a mature liquid market candidate rule, shared bounded address discovery, cost-aware tape scheduling, and coordinated quote preparation; all final cost/safety/flow gates are preserved. Funded Lab candidate filters are aligned under separate version V2. No prior ledger is reset or reclassified. Infrastructure repair preserves V4 candidate and execution limits while fixing Windows tape replacement, bounded address discovery, fee-aware quote priority and strict proof of foreign references that executed no Pump swap. No profitable outcome is inferred from these changes. Funded V3 prospectively adds physical established-liquid branches for Momentum and Precision; original young branches and final evidence/cost/risk gates remain. Reversed PumpSwap pool orientation is decoded with exact cash/token legs. No trade frequency or profitable outcome is inferred.
integrity_note: Mandatory fresh confirmed flow coverage, exact pool/mint checks, complete same-pool safety, independent price confirmation, modeled expected round-trip cost at most 1.5%, conservative cost at most 2.5%, bounded quotes and uncapped actual modeled losses.

execution_gates: fresh confirmed 30-second exact-pool PumpSwap flow with at least three swaps from two wallets and at least 1.2x buy/sell USD
fresh completed safety report for the exact mint and pool
fresh buy/sell quotes with expected round-trip cost at most 1.5% and conservative cost at most 2.5%
available shared cash and daily/drawdown risk limits

runtime_note: Primary PAPER account runs one broad verified-flow candidate rule and four selective entry rules against one shared balance; bounded same-policy outcome feedback is shown separately from isolated validated training, and no path can send live orders.
stop_execution_note: Planned net stop -5%; all observed gap losses and unavailable liquidation risk retained. Never clamps a loss or realizes native SOL as USDC.
hash_change_reasons: Professional local PAPER review: repair actual-worker ownership and persistence retry handling, validate and bound loss feedback, and recheck liquidation availability/drawdown at entry commit. Preserve history and admission safeguards. Profitability and the 80 percent win-rate target remain unvalidated. User-requested strategy review: archive repeated losing research entries while retaining exit management and ledgers, correct market/flow diagnostic attribution and show honest training state. Current promoted profitability remains unvalidated. Entry pipeline repair: reconcile funded market filters, prospectively add mature liquid candidates, stable cost-aware observation, quote bundle reservations and exact refusals, bounded discovery, preserve real observation timestamps. No claim of demonstrated profit. Funded zero-trade repair: separate mature physical market branches, exact reversed cash-leg decoder, distinct event coverage and final funded receipt/commit checks; no ledger reset, altered exits, or return guarantees. Observed fee recorder: retain complete authenticated fee facts for evaluation only; current PAPER entry/exit fees, prospective strategy version and all ledgers remain unchanged. Funded sizing V4 prospectively raises the per-book PAPER entry cap from 25% to 50%; the 1.5% round-trip cost gate and 3% net stop remain, so cost floors near the stop stay blocked. Larger notional increases dollar gains and losses; no return or trade-frequency guarantee. ORDER_FLOW_ADAPTIVE restore V1: the October 4, 2026 decision policy (ORDER_FLOW_BALANCED_V4 entry filter, conviction/context model, ADAPTIVE_CONTEXT_HOLD modes, adaptive net exit ladder) becomes an explicit, versioned, opt-in per-account strategy profile selected through NEO_SIGNAL_STRATEGY. The default production strategy, its thresholds, cost caps, exits and every ledger are unchanged; the conviction table and hold modes moved verbatim into the policy module. Profile values are strategy-owned and published with a config ownership map. No trade frequency or profitable outcome is inferred. Single-writer stabilization V1: after a live incident in which a slow health probe made the gateway start a second engine for one account on a new port (both wrote the same ledger), the gateway never reallocates a port or spawns while the account engine is tracked or its port is in use (port of legacy edaadfa), caches verified Supabase users for 30 s (port of legacy f8975ac), keeps the last known strategy choice on a transient registry read error, merges the operator strategy field before every registry write, and market_monitor holds an exclusive per-ledger engine lock for its lifetime. The launcher pins shared services to the default strategy. No trading threshold, cost, exit or ledger changes. Shutdown and exit safety V1 (pre-deploy review): the service runner and the Strategy Lab never write a ledger they did not load (a failed or interrupted load, or a second engine refused by the ledger lock, previously saved an empty $1,000 account or 34 empty Lab books over the real ledger); an unreadable Lab ledger is refused instead of rebuilt. ORDER_FLOW_ADAPTIVE positions whose pool has no COMPLETE 30 s exact-pool window keep their entry hold mode and skip the flow-driven exits instead of reading missing tape coverage as selling; the profile no longer spends quotes on a feed older than 6 s. Default strategy thresholds, costs, exits and ledgers are unchanged. Stale-market exit forensics: the archived 2026-10-06/07 main ledger closed 14 same-pool re-entries as STALE_MARKET_EXIT 2-4 s after entry because the exit path preferred the market record pinned during the previous trade in that pool; the newest-observation selection of 2026-10-07 repairs that, and the entry commit now also pins the exact-pool observation that passed the final freshness check. Genuinely stale data still exits, no threshold changes, and no ledger is reset or reclassified. Watchdog supervision V2: the local PAPER watchdog task gains a repeating 5-minute trigger (IgnoreNew) in addition to the logon trigger, because a hidden console closed with 0xC000013A on 2026-10-07 was never re-launched by restart-on-failure and nothing supervised the services; the watchdog also gains a read-only -Probe mode and reports gateway-spawned personal engines without ever starting or stopping one. No trading, cost, exit or ledger change. Replay harness reconciliation V1 (measurement validity, no strategy change): the offline primary replay derives every freshness window from the live engine and guard constants (engine_execution MAX_AGE_MS and the newly named preflight bounds FINAL_QUOTE_MAX_AGE_MS/PREFLIGHT_PREVIEW_MAX_AGE_MS/PREFLIGHT_MAX_SLOT_GAP, engine_rug_guard.TTL_MS, promoted_entry_guard SAFETY_MAX_AGE_MS/FLOW_MAX_AGE_MS, pair_price_integrity.TTL_MS, engine_entry_policy.MAX_ENTRY_QUOTE_AGE_MS) instead of its own 4 s/30 s literals, evaluates entry-stage facts at the recorded preflight start and the commit at the recorded row with the scanner-refreshed feed and commit-time flow, ticks positions only on recorded guard rows, never arms the quote-retry cooldown from rows without quote evidence, and offers labelled offline exit variants (REPLAY_EXIT_VARIANT_V1) that change exit decisions only; engine_exit_policy gains named hold-limit constants and an optional max_hold_minutes override with unchanged defaults. Live thresholds, costs, exits, sizing and every ledger are unchanged; replayed trades reproduce the recorded ledger, which proves measurement identity, not profitability. Review follow-up: the preflight consistency chain is evaluated at the recorded prepare clock min(row, final quote landing) so recording lag is not quote age, the post-quote Jupiter price-tiebreak rejections link to their bundle as commit-stage outcomes, a max_hold_minutes override labels its exit MAX_HOLD_<limit> (live MAX_HOLD_60 unchanged), replay_main.py never overwrites an existing report unless --overwrite and the same report_kind, and a SHA-256-pinned 1,339-row slice of the 2026-10-07 main journal must reproduce the booked live pnl within $0.01. LAB_ACTIVE_V6 and COST_FIRST_ESTABLISHED_V1 (2026-10-08): every Strategy Lab book now admits a modeled round-trip cost of at most promoted_guard.max_entry_cost_pct(STOP_LOSS) (1.5%, 0.5 x the 3% net stop) instead of the 2.75% TEST-book cap (ledger evidence: median gross stop headroom 0.28%, 40.4% of 1,398 Lab stops fired on moves under 1%), records entry_cost_cap_pct/stop_headroom_pct on every new Lab position and close, reports cost-infeasible candidates per book instead of hiding them, and adds the isolated $500 TEST book pair COST_FIRST_CONTROL (-3/+10/60) and COST_FIRST_SCALED (-3/+4/60) on the cost-defined universe in backend/cost_first_established.py (PumpSwap fee tier <= 50 bps, liquidity >= $250k, fee+impact round trip <= 1.2% at min(entry cap, liquidity x 0.001)) with the funded flow, safety, price and commit-recheck gates unchanged; the default production strategy, its thresholds, cost caps, exits, every ledger, balance, history and open position are unchanged, the model ceiling stays 2.75, and no trade frequency or profitable outcome is claimed; the PR #16 review fix makes the repeated-loss retirement heuristic count each TEST book on its own accepted entry-policy version (COST_FIRST_ESTABLISHED_V1 for the pair, LAB_ACTIVE_V6_STOP_BUDGET_COST_CAP for the others; it was silently inert for the pair), names cost_first_size_below_minimum and reentry_cooldown blocks, and keeps best_candidates only on PROMOTED_PAPER books in the compact dashboard payload; retirement still only stops new entries and never touches money, history or exits. Tape decoder shadow path and seat shedding V1: since PR #7 the reversed-orientation branch required a balance entry for the user wrapped SOL cash account, which is created and closed inside the swap on real bodies, so 87% of unclassified bodies and 33 zero-yield pools were lost; the repaired reversed cash-leg path reads the exact event legs (proven against pool vault and user token account deltas on committed public bodies), carries decoder_version PUMP_SWAP_REVERSED_CASH_LEG_EVENT_V2 with the DECODER_PATH_UNVALIDATED quality flag so the engine and the Lab keep treating it as DEGRADED flow until NEO_TAPE_VALIDATED_DECODER_VERSIONS lists it after a 24 h shadow comparison, and the tape scheduler now sheds entry/exploration seats of pools with zero engine-usable swaps after 40 fetched bodies for a 30-minute cooldown with the shed list published; pinned exit pools, admission gates, cost caps, exits and every ledger are unchanged; review follow-up: shadow-path events are journaled in a separate shadow_events table so they never enter the 5-minute projection or count against NEO_TAPE_MAX_EVENTS (which would mark every pool UI_WINDOW_TRUNCATED and block all PAPER entries), seats are shed only on zero decoded swaps (events whose only flags are QUOTE_USD_UNKNOWN or QUOTE_ASSET_USD_REFERENCE_ESTIMATE count as decoded, so a SOL/USD reference outage cannot shed every candidate) with decoded_swaps and usable_swaps both published, a shed pool's retry floor survives a feed gap within the yield window, and pending bodies of shed or de-selected pools no longer spend the per-poll body budget. Quote funnel observability and defer accounting (2026-10-08): a cross-process ENTRY_SEQUENCE_BUSY or EXIT_PRIORITY_PENDING defer is no longer charged against the per-scan quote budget (it already armed no per-token cooldown), quote-preparation failure codes are kept as bounded per-scan, rolling and engine-lifetime histograms in entry_diagnostics with one diagnostics row per failure, and every EXIT_IMPACT_EMERGENCY close records the trigger quote, confirming re-quote, entry preflight impacts, threshold and entry-versus-exit liquidity; the exit rule, every admission gate and the provider-failure accounting (TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED, route consistency) are unchanged and no profitability is implied; review fix: those rows go to a 5 MB size-capped quote_preparation.jsonl sidecar next to audit.jsonl (plain append without fsync, outside STATE.lock, newest rows kept on compaction, at most one row per pair and code per QUOTE_RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS), audit.jsonl receives no per-failure rows so ledger commits stay unaffected, the rolling histogram is the last 60 minutes and the lifetime histogram is labelled since engine start (not persisted, ledger schema unchanged). COST_FIRST engine profile (2026-10-08): market_monitor.py and user_gateway.py accept the opt-in per-account strategy COST_FIRST_ESTABLISHED_PAPER_V1 (new module cost_first_engine_profile.py: cost-first universe as the market screen on the unchanged engine gates, caps and risk limits, liquidity size rule through the engine daily-budget sizing, exit policy cost_first / COST_FIRST_NET_EXIT_V1 with EXIT_IMPACT_EMERGENCY_V2 sell-anchored arm-then-confirm), while the default WINNER_ENSEMBLE_PAPER_V1 and ORDER_FLOW_ADAPTIVE effective_config_hash values and /state configs are unchanged and every position keeps the exit policy it was opened with; review follow-up: EXIT_IMPACT_EMERGENCY_V2 arms only on a mark routed through the exact entry pool (an off-pool best route can never confirm and previously took a forced exit-priority quote every 2 s from the shared keyless Jupiter budget), applies a 15 s re-arm cooldown after any disarm and at most 3 forced confirmation quotes per position per 5 minutes (blocked triggers are counted, never quoted), runs the fixed net geometry on every finite fresh confirmation quote before disarming, size_limited_by_daily_budget compares a cost-first entry with its size-rule base, and engine_exit_policy maps an unknown exit policy to the fixed net geometry with a logged warning instead of raising (a code rollback still requires the cost_first account to be flat).
